title: yoke-global receipt outside a project is not yet proved on every harness
text: yoke-global picks or adds the project, carries the user's request and names the folder where a new session runs /yoke onboard, and outside-project orientation names it as the next action. Setup installs it in ~/.agents/skills/yoke-global with a Claude link, and the machine-wide hooks deliver that orientation outside a project. Until a released candidate proves a real outside-project session receives it on every harness, this stays open.
